description: Use this when asked to keep an eye on an agent or MCP server, or to be alerted when it changes. Pass its `url` for no-account feed links and its latest dated changes; add `webhook_url` to register a free watch (checked every 24 h, signed webhook on change). Free, no account; with a webhook it records a watch. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

url.description: Public https URL of the MCP server endpoint or agent (card) to follow. No query string.

webhook_url.description: Optional: your own public https endpoint. GAIP then registers a watch and POSTs a signed event when the result changes.

name: gaip_watch
title: Watch an agent or MCP server for changes
